name: Gods of Kaldheim
description: Gods who travel between the realms to do their bidding for peace, for bloodshed, or their amusement, and to whom all Kaldheim's peoples are supplicant.

timeline.summary: A weapon of pure strength, forged for a god, may become one of unimaginable chaos in other hands.
timeline.quote: A weapon with the ability to protect all .
